nodes.label: W-250 — Phase 1's first seven entries seated
nodes.rationale: Sixteen of forty-one Phase 1 rows disposed; seven are subject matter and seat as registers 1842–1848, the rest are work matter and are recorded in the working register.

nodes.label: Register 1842 — §32.1.1's extent
nodes.rationale: The book has 36 chapters and 7 appendices, and bookindex.py is bounded by the old numbers three times over (APP='ABCDEF', 1<=r<=35, n=41) — three constants, not a reading, so no re-run can count Chapter 36 or Appendix G. The claim count is current; the three box-dependent figures are stale because the box is.

nodes.label: Register 1843 — K I nd's reach
nodes.rationale: The table's other two rows fix the reading, and neither candidate is the printed 45.7. It resolves from the book's own collection with no outside data, and the thesis is strengthened: a channel reaching 13 is further from its ν_V of 160 than one reaching 45.7.

nodes.label: Register 1844 — §24.13's end rule
nodes.rationale: Only the neutral end fails; the prose and caption say 'the neutral' and are right while the summary row and blockquote say 'an end' and 'the ends'. All four sit on one page, and the two that are right are named so a repair does not touch them.

nodes.label: Register 1845 — V = 4ν/3 printed as an identity
nodes.rationale: Twenty-four occurrences on twenty-two lines print it as an identity while one site states it as asymptotic with its error; the bare form is low by 8.33 % at ν = 2, twelve times the two-term asymptotic's 0.69 %.

nodes.label: Register 1846 — the σ collision
nodes.rationale: Decided by the two formulas and no data: substituting Rule 4's σ into §22.5's r cancels the ν³ exactly, so if they were one quantity §22.5's own next sentence would be false. One is a fit's prediction standard error, the other the levels' measurement uncertainty.

nodes.label: Register 1847 — 'palindromic iff self-dual' is false one way
nodes.rationale: A six-element counterexample is printed in the entry, found by exhaustive search over strictly graded posets and the smallest there is. §11.8's conclusion stands because it uses the contrapositive of the direction that holds; what falls is the biconditional.

nodes.label: Register 1848 — §14.3's bundling claim
nodes.rationale: The claim is true and the cited experiment does not show it — eighty of eighty both ways is a report that bundling changed nothing. Its general reason, 'with two coordinates ℛ(X) = X for every X', was later measured wrong at W-254.

nodes.label: The emphasis-parity guard in the build instrument
nodes.rationale: r2-reg7a2's pinned count of entries with an odd asterisk total is 22, a finding about the Register and not about the author, so G0c forbids bumping it to 24; the build was discarded, the delimiters repaired at source, and the instrument now asserts even asterisk parity so the class is unreachable rather than merely absent.

nodes.label: The digit-coincidence class in bare-number scans
nodes.rationale: The recomputed kinds table prints 196 and 1,363 and the instrument's bare-number scan reads them as register pointers — the class the retraction audit named. Recorded; the instrument is not touched.

nodes.label: The gate caught a stray .out in members/
nodes.rationale: gate_live.py enrols every .out in members/, so a file written there by a command run from the wrong directory produced an ERROR for a vprice.py that is not a member. The gate caught it, which is what it is for.
